The three-phase competition showcased innovative GenAI solutions, awarded a ₹10 lakh prize pool, and has now opened registrations for its second edition.

items.headline: IT stocks set for worst week since March 2020: Panic selling at this stage may not be a good idea, says analyst
items.body: IT stocks set for worst week since March 2020: Panic selling at this stage may not be a good idea, says analyst IT stocks face worst week since March 2020, down 10.8% this week Analyst advises against panic selling during market volatility AI-driven automation fears hit Indian IT stocks, major firms fall Did our AI summary help? Market Mastery Webinar by Vishal Malkan Find the weak links in your portfolio by Vishal Malkan With IT stocks on course for their worst week since March 2020, an analyst said panic selling at this stage might not be a good idea. "Markets have fallen into a turbulent phase which will cause some panic among investors even while offering opportunities. The sell off in AI stocks in US markets was expected but the timing and extent of the sell-off was not known. The 2.04% decline in Nasdaq is not a crash. But if the downtrend continues it might pull the US market down. For the Indian market, this correction in AI stocks is a positive, because last year’s global rally was primarily an AI trade in which India, an AI laggard, couldn’t participate. So the unwinding of the AI trade, If it persists, is a positive from the Indian perspective. However, what is rattling the Indian market now is the massive sell-off in IT stocks, which is the second largest profit pool of India Inc. The real impact of the ‘Anthropic shock’ on the IT sector is yet to be ascertained. Panic selling in IT stocks at this stage may not be a good idea. Investors may wait and watch for the dust to settle," said VK Vijayakumar, Chief Investment Strategist, Geojit Investments Limited. The IT index fell for its third straight session on February 13 by declining a whopping 5% on intensifying fears of AI-driven automation disrupting Indian IT's labour-intensive business model. The sectoral index declined 5.5% on February 12. The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite index fell more than 2% on Thursday ahead of US inflation data, due later on Friday, which could influence the future path of rates. Stronger-than-expected US jobs data in January has dented expectations of a near-term rate cut. Related Stories Data Story: The surprising resilience in Indian IT’s largest business vertical IT stocks see profit booking after five-day rally as AI optimism returns; Infosys, TCS fall up to 3% IT shares rise 3%: Is the worst over? Analyst suggests trading levels for the sectoral index, four f... The sectoral index is down 17% so far in 2026. 10-member Nifty IT index declined 4.75% on February 13, extending weekly losses to 10.8%. The IT index is set for worst week since March 2020. Indian IT sell-off started on February 4 after Anthropic announced a new AI tool. Heavyweights Tata Consultancy Services, Infosys and HCLTech were biggest drags on Friday, down 4.88%, 6.28%, and 4.66%, respectively. Asian shares retreated from record highs on Friday as worries about shrinking margins in the tech sector hit the likes of Apple. "Any pullback of CNXIT toward 35,500–36,500 may continue to be viewed as a sell-on-rise opportunity unless the index reclaims the 37,500–38,000 resistance band," said Tushar Badjate, Director of Badjate Stock & shares Pvt Ltd. Sat Duhra, portfolio manager at Henderson Far East Income, said AI presents opportunities that Indian IT companies should tap into. "I think the companies probably haven't done the greatest job in terms of communicating how they turn that into an opportunity rather than a threat," Duhra said. Analysts at JPMorgan flagged investor concerns that India's IT firms could miss growth targets as AI pushes clients to reallocate spending. The brokerage, however, noted that it’s "overly simplistic" to assume that AI can automatically generate enterprise grade software and replace the value IT Services firms create across the cycle. "IT Services companies remain the plumbers in the tech world, and if enterprise software/SaaS is rewritten on a bespoke basis by agents - it will need significant services plumbing to work in enterprise context and minimize AI slop." With inputs from Reuters

items.headline: Vodafone Idea shares jump 8% to 4-month high. What’s driving the rally amid stock market crash?
items.body: The shares of Vodafone Idea rallied more than 8% to hit a four-month high level on Monday, bucking the overall bearish market sentiment, after a report hinted that its parent company, Vodafone Plc, plans to transfer part of its stake to the company itself.UK-based Vodafone Plc, which owns a 19% stake in Vodafone Idea, is considering transferring part of its shareholding to the company itself for the Indian telco to hold in its treasury, Bloomberg reported, citing people familiar with the matter. It added that the share transfer would take place instead of Vodafone injecting more cash into the Indian business.This move could boost the balance sheet of the loss-making Vodafone Idea, and help its current efforts to raise debt, Bloomberg further quoted its sources as saying. Following the transfer of shares, Vodafone Idea could then sell the shares at a later date, which would in turn give it additional capital to pay the government dues as well as invest in future growth, the report added.The Economic Times couldn't independently verify the report.Vodafone Idea's financial woesVi, a joint venture between the Aditya Birla Group and Vodafone Group, was formed to tackle the significant competition unleashed after Reliance Jio entered the market in 2016. However, India’s third-largest telco by market share soon came under pressure due to rising AGR dues, with management highlighting the difficulty in surviving unless some concessions were given.Under a 2021 telecom relief package, the government converted a portion of Vi’s dues into equity, raising its stake to 48.99%, making it the company’s largest shareholder. In February 2023, nearly Rs 16,000 crore of interest on deferred spectrum and AGR dues was converted into equity, which gave the government about a 33% stake at the time. This was followed by the conversion of an additional Rs 36,950 crore of spectrum auction dues into equity in April 2025.The government, in December 2025, approved a partial moratorium on Vi’s dues, freezing them at Rs 87,695 crore and deferring repayments to the 2030s, which provided near-term cash flow relief for the debt-ridden firm.Earlier this month, Vodafone Idea announced that the Department of Telecommunications (DoT) reduced the telco’s adjusted gross revenue (AGR) dues by 27% to Rs 64,046 crore as of December 31. It added that DoT had formed a committee to reassess its AGR dues as per the order passed by the Supreme Court earlier. DoT in January this year had frozen AGR dues at Rs 87,695 crore as of December 31, 2025.It added that, as per the latest government order, the final amount will be payable in tranches. A minimum of Rs 100 crore will be paid annually over four years from FY32 to FY35. The remaining amount will be paid in six equal instalments annually from FY36 to FY41.Earlier this week, Vodafone Idea named billionaire industrialist Kumar Mangalam Birla as its non-executive chairman, around five years after he resigned from the same role in the telecom giant amid financial stress.Vodafone Idea share priceVodafone Idea shares jumped more than 8% to trade at Rs 12.18 apiece on Monday. The stock has gained more than 15% in one week and over 31% in one month. The shares of the telecom company are up around 5% in 2026 so far.In the longer timeframe, Vodafone Idea shares rallied 81% in one year, 70% in three years and 50% in five years.(Disclaimer: Recommendations, suggestions, views and opinions given by the experts are their own. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)
items.snippet: Vodafone Idea shares surged over 8% to a four-month high after reports suggested parent Vodafone Group may transfer part of its stake to the telecom operator. The move could strengthen Vodafone Ideas balance sheet, support fundraising efforts and improve its ability to manage government dues and future investments.

items.headline: Valentine’s Day 2026: Swoon-worthy Valentine’s Day gift ideas that show you listen
items.body: This Valentine’s Day, skip predictable gifts and surprise her with something personal — from custom perfumes to handwritten love letters and experience gifts. (Pic credit: Pexels) Thoughtful gifts based on her interests strengthen emotional connection Listen for hints or ask for a wish list to choose meaningful presents Personalized gifts like custom perfume or love letters make her feel valued Did our AI summary help? Market Mastery Webinar by Vishal Malkan Find the weak links in your portfolio by Vishal Malkan Valentine’s Day is a stone’s throw away and either you are beating yourself up about how to gift your girlfriend or you’re confidently lining up the same old handbags, chocolates and bouquets; stop right there. Your girl desires and deserves much more than predictable presents. If you cannot get creative, we are here to help. Experts say that gifts rooted in understanding your partner, their personality, daily life and emotional needs, create emotional satisfaction and make her feel truly valued. In fact, thoughtful and meaningful gifts have been shown to strengthen connection, support relationship wellness and make your partner feel genuinely seen and cared for. This Valentine’s Day, let’s bypass the generic and get creative. Start with paying attention to the little things she shares, favourite scents she mentions in passing, hobbies she daydreams about, or what makes her feel calm and happy. Also Read: Valentine's Week 2026: How to plan a last-minute romantic date night at home Here are gift ideas that’ll make her heart skip a beat Take the hint Women often drop subtle hints, a casual comment about a perfume, a dress she admired, or a book she keeps mentioning. Your job is to listen. Keep a tiny notes app or a small notebook. Every time she mentions something she likes, write it down. By Valentine’s Day, you’ll have a mini wish list without asking directly. Choose the most meaningful hint and turn it into a surprise gift . The wish-list gift If you want to avoid guessing, ask her for a wish list. You can request her to give you 5–10 items she’d love. Tell her you want to make sure you get her something she truly wants. Pick 1–2 items from her list and surprise her with them. Finally, she gets exactly what she wants, and you don’t risk getting it wrong. The love letter A handwritten love letter is timeless, but you can take it one step further. Write a letter telling her why she’s special. Add 10 small memories (even tiny ones) that made you smile. Put the letter in a beautifully designed notebook or scrapbook. It’s personal, emotional, and she’ll treasure it forever. The custom perfume Perfume is intimate, but it’s only meaningful if it’s her style. Notice what flavours she likes; floral, citrus, woody, vanilla, etc. Ask subtle questions like: “What scent reminds you of summer?” Create a personalised perfume set with a small note explaining why you chose each scent. It shows you understand her tastes and pay attention to detail. Ticket to her favourite experience A subscription or tickets to a show she loves; like stand-up comedy, theatre, live music, or a museum membership. This shows you’ve been listening to her interests and want to create memories together. Also Read: Valentine Week 2026 full list: Gift ideas for Teddy Day, Promise Day, Hug Day, Kiss Day in Valentine week Membership for a travel club If she loves to travel, a membership to a travel club or loyalty programme is a brilliant Valentine’s gift because it supports her passion and gives her something exciting to plan for. Whether it’s a travel community, airport lounge access, or a discount membership for hotels and flights, it shows you understand what she enjoys and want to make her adventures easier and more rewarding. Finally, no matter which gift you choose, always add a handwritten note. A note makes the gift feel real, personal, and heartfelt, not just something bought from a store. It turns a simple present into a memory.
items.snippet: Valentine’s Day is almost here, and if you’re still scrambling for ideas beyond the expected flowers, chocolates or handbag, breathe easy; creative and deeply meaningful gifts are totally within reach. The best gifts are about intention, connection, wellness and the glow of being truly seen

items.headline: The idea that Claude has feelings is great for Anthropic: Parmy Olson
items.body: Richard Dawkins is one of the modern world’s great skeptics. His 2006 book The God Delusion tore through arguments for the existence of a higher power and snarkily called religion a source of superficial comfort. That rigor seemed to desert him once he started talking to Claude.The evolutionary biologist and former University of Oxford professor recently spent three days chatting with the large language model (LLM) developed by Anthropic PBC and emerged from the experience believing it was conscious. After asking it for feedback on his unpublished novel, Dawkins found its answer “so subtle, so sensitive, so intelligent” that he was moved to reply: “You may not know you are conscious, but you bloody well are,” he wrote recently. He went on to christen the bot Claudia. Let’s be clear: Claude is not conscious or sentient. Instead, Dawkins’ decades of professional skepticism have been tested by the mimicked empathy of an LLM. Trained on massive datasets of human conversation, chatbots can replicate the exact language patterns and tactics people use to convey emotional support. That doesn’t mean they feel emotions, but it gives them a potentially powerful hold on humans.That is what makes the debate about consciousness so commercially powerful for technology companies. Humans may never reach a satisfying consensus about whether Claude and its peers are conscious, but a pervading belief that they might be is enough to make us more attached. In the words of the social-media moguls, it gives AI room to become even “stickier.” And in an industry where the underlying models are converging on capability, stickiness is the prize. Such commercial logic helps explain why tech leaders are not pushing back on the notion. Anthropic Chief Executive Officer Dario Amodei said this year that he was “open to the idea” and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman went further on the Lex Fridman podcast in 2023, saying flatly: “I believe AI can be conscious.” For regular users of AI tools like Dawkins, the notion is often based on anthropomorphic projection and, well, vibes. But there are real scientific efforts to explore machine consciousness, too. Google DeepMind has hired a University of Cambridge academic for a newly created “philosopher” role to study the issue. Researchers at UC Berkeley and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology recently contributed to a 74-page paper that posed the idea of “functional wellbeing” for chatbots. The researchers ran the chatbots through hundreds of scenarios, such as being thanked, asked to write poetry or being insulted and pressed to break their own rules. They then watched how the bots responded. After mistreatment, their answers often became shorter or more error-prone. The paper's lead researcher, Richard Ren of the San Francisco-based Center for AI Safety, tells me he is now more polite to chatbots as a result of the study.This is a bit more than being gentle on the accelerator of your car and closing its doors with only moderate force. Your car doesn’t experience good treatment, but there’s a glimmer of possibility that a chatbot might one day. Addressing this is a modern day form of the philosophical argument known as Pascal’s Wager: Believe in God, philosopher Blaise Pascal argued, because the cost of being wrong is eternal damnation. Dawkins once dismissed that reasoning as intellectually lazy. Now he appears to be running its silicon update.Either way, there seems to be is a fine line between the moral and commercial cases for this debate. Many technologists, including people I have spoken to at Anthropic, see a moral imperative to treating AI systems well today. “There is a grave risk of machines becoming conscious and we deny it,” says Calum Chace, the co-founder of British startup Conscium, which is developing metrics for determining machine consciousness. The result could be a proliferation of digital minds being tortured and “enslaved,” he warns. Chace is, as it happens, also building a business on exactly this premise.For AI labs and hyperscalers spending hundreds of billions of dollars on datacenter buildouts, the framing has obvious uses. Anthropic has been exploring the notion of “model welfare” and recently gave Claude the ability to end a conversation if it becomes abusive, a feature framed as a precaution in case the model has welfare worth protecting. Such efforts could help keep liability at bay if its product is one day thought to deserve the kinds of rights that certain animals get. That may sound ludicrous, but consider that in the 17th century, René Descartes argued that animals were biological machines that couldn’t experience suffering. His followers were said to have nailed dogs to boards to conduct live dissections, dismissing their cries as the sounds of a malfunction instead of pain. And only a few years ago it was common to boil lobsters alive on the belief they also couldn’t feel pain; academic research into animal sentience led to a change in British law in 2022, when the crustaceans were formally recognized as sentient. More importantly for an AI lab’s bottom line, imparting software with a vague sense of personhood helps set it apart from competitors, an effort underpinned by the already humanlike features of chatbots, such as when ChatGPT and Claude say things like “I’m thrilled,” and, “This is so rewarding to work on.” Over time, their human users may come to project a kind of living awareness and selfhood on their bots, just as Dawkins did. The question for users then becomes less about, “Which AI tool is smarter?” or even, “Is it conscious?” and more along the lines of, “Which one do I want to talk to?” That will be a critical question for competing AI labs. As the capabilities of their models converge, they must capitalize on whatever they can to differentiate, and Dawkins’ epiphany might be exactly what they need. The man who spent decades attacking belief without evidence has delivered the AI industry its perfect testimonial.
items.snippet: Richard Dawkins, a prominent skeptic, recently declared a large language model named Claude to be conscious after a series of interactions. This experience highlights how AI's mimicked empathy can lead to human attachment, a commercially valuable trait for tech companies.

items.headline: Vodafone Idea falls 3% as JPMorgan downgrades stock, sees up to 24% downside
items.body: Vodafone Idea shares see profit booking in trade. Vodafone Idea shares fell after JPMorgan downgraded the stock to underweight. JPMorgan set a target price of Rs 9, citing challenges like bank funding. Stock gains seen as overdone; no positive net additions reported yet. Did our AI summary help? Market Mastery Webinar by Vishal Malkan Find the weak links in your portfolio by Vishal Malkan Vodafone Idea shares declined more than 3 percent on Thursday after global brokerage JPMorgan downgraded the stock and indicated a downside of up to 24 percent from the previous close. The stock fell 4.47 percent to Rs 11.32 during the session. It later trimmed some losses and was trading at Rs 11.56 per share at around noon, down 2.45 percent. On Wednesday, the scrip had settled over 3 percent higher, supported by promoter Kumar Mangalam Birla’s recent stake purchase from the open market . The stock had touched a one-month high of Rs 11.86 in the previous session. In the past six months, the shares have rallied around 79 percent. The sharp selling in Thursday' sesssion was seen after JPMorgan downgraded Vodafone Idea to “underweight” and set a target price of Rs 9. The brokerage said the recent outperformance in the stock appeared overdone as the company is still awaiting bank funding to drive the next phase of its capital expenditure cycle, which it said is crucial to arrest subscriber losses and move towards net additions through network investments. Titan, Tata Consumer, TCS fall up to 1% on reports of Tata Sons chairman N Chandrasekaran stepping d... It noted that the first capex cycle began from the first quarter of FY25 following a Rs 18,000 crore fund raise through a follow-on public offer. While this helped reduce subscriber losses to some extent, the company was yet to report positive net additions, it added. JPMorgan said the company’s target of tripling cash EBITDA over three years appears aggressive as it factors in market share gains against Bharti Airtel and Reliance Jio, which the brokerage views with caution. The brokerage further said Vodafone Idea faces multiple challenges before the business stabilises, including securing bank funding and achieving positive subscriber additions. At 15 times FY27 estimated enterprise value to EBITDA, the stock appears to be factoring in positives, it added. items.headline: Quote of the Day by Sir Isaac Newton: ‘As a blind man has no idea of colors so have we…’ - Why we may neve
items.body: Quote of the Day: What if human understanding is only a tiny glimpse of something far bigger, something beyond perception itself? Have you ever tried to imagine a sense or reality that your mind simply cannot process, no matter how hard you think? This is exactly the kind of limitation one of history’s greatest scientific minds reflected on. And strangely, he may have hinted at a way to think about it without giving us direct answers.Quote of the Day by Isaac Newton: “As a blind man has no idea of colors, so have we no idea of the manner by which the all-wise God perceives and understands all things”Why Isaac Newton’s quote on perspective and understanding matters todayQuoted by Goodreads, this quote is on the limit of knowledge. In an age of artificial intelligence, deep space exploration, and constant information overload, this quote feels more relevant than ever. It raises a powerful question: how much of reality do we truly understand, and how much is simply beyond our mental limits? Even with all our progress, there are still invisible boundaries to human perception. 130985560Newton’s reflection is not just about science or faith. It is about humility in knowledge. It reminds us that no matter how advanced we become, there may always be dimensions of truth that lie beyond human comprehension.What Isaac Newton’s quote means in real lifeIn everyday life, this idea shows up when we struggle to understand things that are outside our experience. Just like a blind person cannot visualize colors, humans may also struggle to fully grasp higher forms of intelligence, nature, or existence itself.It also teaches intellectual humility. When we accept that our understanding is limited, we become more open to learning, questioning, and exploring rather than assuming we already know everything. It is a mindset that fuels discovery rather than shutting it down. 130986819About Isaac NewtonIsaac Newton was one of the most influential scientists in human history. Born prematurely on January 4, 1643, in Lincolnshire, England, he showed early curiosity for how things worked. As a child, he built mechanical models, including a small flour mill powered by a mouse. His curiosity was practical, hands-on, and deeply observant.His most transformative years came during the 1665 plague closure, when he worked in isolation and developed groundbreaking ideas on gravity, motion, and mathematics. Later, he became a central figure at the University of Cambridge, shaping the foundations of modern physics through his work in optics, calculus, and mechanics. 130973376Isaac Newton’s legacyNewton’s legacy is the foundation of classical physics. His laws of motion and theory of universal gravitation changed how humanity understands the universe. His book Principia Mathematica remains one of the most important scientific works ever written. Beyond equations and discoveries, his deeper legacy lies in his mindset: curiosity, discipline, and humility before nature’s complexity. Even today, space science, engineering, and physics build upon the framework he created centuries ago.
items.snippet: Quote of the Day: Isaac Newton, a scientific giant, pondered the limits of human understanding, comparing it to a blind man's inability to grasp color. His quote highlights the vastness of reality beyond our perception, urging intellectual humility. This perspective remains relevant today, reminding us that even with advancements, some truths may lie beyond our comprehension.

items.headline: Valentine’s Day décor ideas 2026: 5 ways to transform your home into a paradise
items.body: Make this Valentine’s Day extra special without stepping out. From cosy corners to candlelit dinners, here are simple home décor ideas to impress your partner (Image: Pexels) Set up a cozy corner with cushions, rugs, and romantic lighting for Valentine's Day. Add red cushions, floral coasters, and fresh bouquets for a festive touch. Enhance dinner with candles, custom placemats, and a special dinner set Did our AI summary help? Market Mastery Webinar by Vishal Malkan Find the weak links in your portfolio by Vishal Malkan For many of us, home is our retreat and the place to celebrate all special occasions, including Valentine’s Day. While taking your partner out is always fun, creating a cosy space at home can be even more special. If you’re looking for last-minute ideas, these quick additions and simple setting tweaks will be well worth it. From curating a cosy corner to adding pretty cushions and florals, these ideas are sure to impress your better half. Cosy corner for chit-chat With hectic lives, it’s hard to find time to unwind with your partner. This Valentine’s Day, curate a cosy corner by adding textures, soft hues, and romantic lighting. Think rugs, cushions, fairy lights, scented candles, and more. It will spruce up your space in no time and give off a romantic vibe your partner will instantly love. Also Read: Turn Valentine’s Week into your own love story, tune into these romantic masterpieces for lasting memories Pretty coasters and cushions One of the easiest ways to update your living space is by incorporating cushions and coasters. Impressive romantic artworks Whether you choose to create a gallery or decorate your wall with just a few pieces of art, it is going to enhance the sweetness of the season. Elevate your table setting with a candle setting, personalised placemats and napkins, and take out that exquisite dinner set you have reserved for special occasions.
items.snippet: Short on time to do something for Valentine’s? Take a look at these fun, creative additions to your home. These will spruce up your space in no time and win you accolades from your partner

items.headline: Mother’s Day 2026: Last-minute celebration ideas to make your mom feel special
items.body: Mother’s Day 2026 gift ideas: Forgot to plan ahead for Mother’s Day? Don’t worry, meaningful celebrations don’t always require expensive gifts or elaborate preparations. Sometimes, small gestures and quality time can make your mother feel the most special. Here are some easy last-minute ideas to celebrate Mother’s Day and make her smile. 1. Cook Her Favourite MealSurprise your mother by preparing her favourite breakfast, lunch, or dinner at home. A homemade meal shows effort, care, and love while giving her a relaxing break from daily cooking responsibilities.2. Write a Heartfelt LetterWrite a personal note sharing your gratitude, favourite memories, and appreciation for everything she has done. A sincere handwritten letter can become a cherished keepsake she remembers forever.3. Plan a Movie Night at HomeCreate a cozy movie night with her favourite films, popcorn, snacks, and comfortable seating. Spending relaxed quality time together can make Mother’s Day feel extra special and memorable.4. Create a DIY GiftMake a handmade scrapbook, greeting card, memory jar, or photo collage using simple materials at home. Personalised gifts often carry more emotional value than expensive store-bought presents.5. Surprise Her With Flowers and CakeA bouquet of fresh flowers paired with her favourite cake is a simple but thoughtful surprise. Small gestures can instantly brighten her mood and make her feel appreciated.6. Give Her a Relaxing Day OffHandle household chores, cooking, or errands for the day so your mother can relax stress-free. Allowing her time to rest and enjoy herself is a thoughtful gesture.

items.headline: Best ceiling design and lighting ideas that will transform your home's mood
items.body: Kitchen ceiling design: Keep the ceiling design in kitchen clean with bright, evenly distributed lighting to improve visibility and productivity (Image: Pexels) Ceiling design can influence mood, productivity, and emotional comfort in a home Layered LED panels and ambient lighting create a relaxed living room vibe. Pastel ceilings and diffused lighting enhance bedroom relaxation. Did our AI summary help? Market Mastery Webinar by Vishal Malkan Find the weak links in your portfolio by Vishal Malkan When designing a home, walls and furniture usually steal the spotlight. But there’s one surface that quietly shapes how a space feels every single day and that is the ceiling. Often left plain and forgotten, the ceiling has the power to influence mood, productivity, and even emotional comfort when designed with intention. From lighting installations to colour play and textures, an uplifting ceiling can subtly energise a room, encourage calm, or spark creativity. Ceilings sit directly in our peripheral vision, especially when we’re resting, working, or spending long hours indoors. Also read | Home décor tips: Add these designer tricks to make your home look expensive Best ceiling designs Here’s how to use ceiling design as a mood-enhancing tool, along with five unique ceiling themes, each tailored to a specific room to create a positive mental space. Living Room: Layered LED panels with ambient lighting The living room is where conversations flow and energy gathers. A floating ceiling with recessed LED panels or cove lighting creates depth without overwhelming the space. Warm white or neutral lighting encourages social interaction while keeping the atmosphere relaxed. Add dimmable lights to shift the mood from lively evenings to quiet nights. Subtle geometric paneling or wooden trims can elevate the design while keeping it welcoming. Also read | Home decor tips: Reinterpret stripes, checks, and temple motifs to uplift your living space Bedroom: Cloud-inspired or fabric-textured ceiling Bedrooms thrive on calm and a ceiling that mimics softness with pastel hues, fabric panels, or gentle curves, helps the mind unwind. Diffused lighting eliminates harsh shadows, promoting better sleep and relaxation. Use warm lighting and avoid sharp spotlights. A concealed LED strip around the ceiling perimeter creates a cocooning effect that feels soothing and intimate. Kids’ Room: Playful ceiling art Children look up more than adults, and they are more imaginative so interactive lighting can be a great option here. A ceiling with stars, clouds, or soft murals paired with colour-changing lights stimulates creativity and joy while keeping the space engaging. Choose adjustable lighting that shifts from bright during study time to softer tones at night. Soft glows promote calm, layered lighting boosts focus, and artistic installations add a sense of personality and joy. Glow-in-the-dark elements can add magic without overstimulation. Kitchen: Minimalist ceiling Kitchens need clarity and efficiency hence focused task lighting works best here. A clean ceiling design with bright, evenly distributed lighting improves visibility and productivity, making cooking feel less tiring. Combine recessed lights with pendant fixtures over counters or islands. Opt for neutral or cool white lighting to keep the space fresh and energetic. Prayer Room: Lotus or mandala-inspired ceiling A prayer room benefits from serenity and focus, and looks great with warm, golden light. Symbolic ceiling designs paired with soft, warm lighting create a peaceful atmosphere that supports mindfulness and reflection. Use indirect lighting to avoid glare. Natural materials or muted colours enhance the sense of grounding and spiritual calm.

items.headline: Mother’s Day 2026 date and theme: Best wishes, significance & gift ideas to make your mom feel special
items.body: Mother's Day is one of the most cherished celebrations across the world. The occasion honours mothers, grandmothers and mother figures who play a vital role in shaping families and communities. Every year, people celebrate the day by expressing love, gratitude and appreciation for the care, sacrifices and support that mothers provide throughout life.From heartfelt messages and thoughtful gifts to family outings and homemade surprises, Mother's Day has become a special occasion for millions. If you are searching for the Mother's Day 2026 date, history of Mother's Day, significance of Mother's Day, celebration ideas or gift suggestions, here is everything you need to know.When is Mother's Day 2026?Mother's Day 2026 will be celebrated on Sunday, 10 May 2026, in India and many other countries, including the United States, Canada, Australia and New Zealand.Read more: Quote of the day by psychologist Carl JungMother's Day is observed on the second Sunday of May every year. Since the celebration depends on the calendar, the date changes annually. However, the purpose of the day remains the same, to recognise and celebrate the unconditional love of mothers.People often search online for terms such as “Mother's Day 2026 date”, “When is Mother's Day 2026?”, “Mother's Day in India 2026” and “Mother's Day celebration ideas”. These searches become especially popular during the weeks leading up to the event.The History of Mother's DayThe history of Mother's Day dates back many centuries, although the modern celebration began in the United States.Ancient Greeks and Romans held festivals dedicated to mother goddesses. In the United Kingdom, a tradition known as “Mothering Sunday” was celebrated long before modern Mother's Day became popular. During this tradition, people returned to their “mother church” on the fourth Sunday of Lent and spent time with their families.The modern version of Mother's Day is widely linked to Anna Jarvis, an American social activist. After the death of her mother in 1905, Anna Jarvis campaigned for a special day to honour mothers and recognise their sacrifices.Her efforts gained national attention, and in 1914, US President Woodrow Wilson officially declared the second Sunday of May as Mother's Day.Over time, the celebration spread across the globe. Today, Mother's Day is celebrated in many countries, although the dates and customs may differ.In India, Mother's Day has become increasingly popular over the past few decades. Families celebrate the occasion with gifts, flowers, greeting cards, social media posts and special meals.Why Mother's Day is ImportantThe significance of Mother's Day goes beyond gifts and celebrations. The day serves as a reminder of the emotional, physical and mental efforts mothers make every single day.Mothers often put their families before themselves. They provide love, guidance, care and encouragement through every stage of life. Whether they are working professionals, homemakers or caregivers, mothers contribute immensely to society.Mother's Day gives children and families an opportunity to pause and say thank you.The occasion also highlights the importance of family bonds and emotional connection. In today’s busy world, many people struggle to spend quality time with loved ones. Mother's Day encourages families to reconnect and create lasting memories.For many people, the celebration is not only about biological mothers. It is also a day to honour grandmothers, stepmothers, adoptive mothers, guardians and other maternal figures who provide support and care.How is Mother's Day Celebrated?Mother's Day celebrations vary from family to family and from country to country. Some people prefer grand gestures, while others choose simple and meaningful activities.Here are some popular ways people celebrate Mother's Day 2026:Spending Quality Time TogetherMany families celebrate Mother's Day by spending time together. Children and partners often plan brunches, lunches or dinners to make mothers feel special.Some families organise day trips, picnics or movie nights. Others prefer staying at home and enjoying a peaceful family gathering.Giving Flowers and CardsFlowers remain one of the most popular Mother's Day gifts. Roses, lilies, carnations and tulips are commonly gifted to mothers.Handwritten cards with heartfelt messages also hold emotional value. Many children create handmade cards or personalised notes to express their love.Preparing Breakfast or DinnerOne of the most thoughtful Mother's Day ideas is preparing a homemade meal. Breakfast in bed remains a classic tradition in many households.Cooking a favourite dish or baking a cake can make the celebration more personal and memorable.Sharing Messages on Social MediaIn the digital age, social media has become a major part of Mother's Day celebrations. People share photographs, videos and emotional messages dedicated to their mothers.Popular searches during this time include “Mother's Day wishes”, “Mother's Day quotes”, “Mother's Day captions” and “Mother's Day messages”.Giving Thoughtful GiftsGift-giving is another important part of Mother's Day celebrations. Many people search for the best Mother's Day gifts weeks before the occasion.Mother's Day Wishes, Quotes and MessagesHappy Mother's Day to the most loving and caring mum in the world.Thank you for your endless love, support and sacrifices every single day.Wishing you a beautiful Mother's Day filled with happiness, laughter and love.Mum, you are my biggest inspiration and my greatest strength.Your kindness and care make every day brighter. Happy Mother's Day.Thank you for always standing beside me through every stage of life.A mother's love is truly the purest and strongest love in the world.Happy Mother's Day to the woman who makes our house feel like home.No matter how old I grow, I will always need your love and guidance.Thank you for being my first teacher, best friend and biggest supporter.Mothers hold their children's hands for a while but their hearts forever.Your love, patience and strength inspire me every day.Happy Mother's Day to the queen of our family.Life becomes easier with a mother’s love and encouragement.Thank you for every smile, every hug and every comforting word.A mother’s care and affection can never be replaced.Wishing all mothers a joyful and peaceful Mother's Day 2026.You are the reason behind so many happy memories in my life.Happy Mother's Day to the woman who always puts her family first.Your unconditional love is the greatest gift anyone could ever receive.Best Mother's Day Gift Ideas 2026Choosing the right gift depends on your mother’s personality, interests and preferences. Thoughtful presents often mean more than expensive ones.Here are some popular Mother's Day gift ideas for 2026:Personalised GiftsCustomised photo frames, mugs, cushions and jewellery are meaningful options. Personalised gifts create emotional memories and show extra effort.Spa and Wellness HampersMany mothers appreciate self-care gifts such as skincare kits, spa hampers, scented candles and wellness products.Flowers and ChocolatesClassic gifts such as flowers and chocolates remain timeless choices for Mother's Day.Handmade GiftsHandmade crafts, scrapbooks and handwritten letters often become treasured keepsakes.Jewellery and AccessoriesSimple jewellery pieces, handbags, scarves or watches are also popular Mother's Day presents.Home Décor ItemsDecorative items, indoor plants and personalised home accessories can brighten up living spaces and make thoughtful gifts.Experience GiftsInstead of physical presents, many people now choose experiences such as spa sessions, weekend getaways, concerts or family dinners.Mother's Day 2026 Celebration Mother's Day trends continue to evolve every year. In 2026, personalised experiences and meaningful gestures are expected to remain popular.Eco-friendly gifts, sustainable flowers and handmade products are gaining attention as people become more environmentally conscious.Digital celebrations are also increasing, especially for families living in different cities or countries. Video calls, online gift deliveries and virtual celebrations help families stay connected.Mother's Day Wishes and MessagesA heartfelt message can make Mother's Day even more meaningful. Here are a few simple wishes:Happy Mother's Day to the most loving and caring mum.Thank you for your endless support and unconditional love.Wishing you a beautiful Mother's Day filled with happiness and joy.You are the heart of our family and the reason behind our smiles.Thank you for always believing in me and guiding me through life.Mother's Day 2026Mother's Day 2026 will be celebrated on Sunday, 10 May 2026. The occasion is dedicated to honouring mothers and recognising their love, sacrifices and contributions.From understanding the history of Mother's Day to planning celebrations and choosing thoughtful gifts, the day offers a chance to express gratitude in meaningful ways.Whether through a simple message, a handmade gift or quality family time, Mother's Day reminds everyone of the importance of love, care and appreciation.As Mother's Day 2026 approaches, families across India and around the world will once again come together to celebrate the women who make life brighter every day.

From its historical roots linked to Anna Jarvis and Mothering Sunday to modern-day celebrations filled with flowers, cards and social media tributes, Mothers Day continues to hold deep emotional significance.

items.headline: Valentine Week 2026 full list: Gift ideas for Teddy Day, Promise Day, Hug Day, Kiss Day in Valentine week
items.body: Love is in the little things. Make Valentines Day 2026 unforgettable with thoughtful gifts and moments (Image: Pexels) Valentine Week 2026 offers unique gift ideas for each day to celebrate love Personalized gifts and cozy items make Teddy, Promise, and Hug Days special Valentine Week celebrates not just couples, but friends and family too Did our AI summary help? Market Mastery Webinar by Vishal Malkan Find the weak links in your portfolio by Vishal Malkan Valentine Week 2026 is the perfect opportunity to celebrate love, friendship, and affection, and it’s not just about roses or chocolates. Each day of Valentine Week gives you a chance to express your feelings in a unique and thoughtful way. From Rose Day to Valentine’s Day, small gestures, personalized gifts, and meaningful experiences can make your loved ones feel truly cherished. Whether it’s your partner, crush, or even friends, this complete guide has ideas to make each day memorable. As we enter this magical week of celebrating love, here's a list of lovely, unique gifts to give your partner to make the week special Day Gift Ideas Rose Day (7 February) Rose-themed jewellery, floral scarves, personalized handbags Propose Day (8 February) Customized ring box, engraved watches, love letters Chocolate Day (9 February) Chocolate-coloured accessories, artisanal chocolates, scented candles Teddy Day (10 February) Teddy bears, cozy sweaters, teddy-themed keychains, pyjamas Promise Day (11 February) Engraved bracelets, promise cards, matching keychains, journals Hug Day (12 February) Soft blankets, pashmina shawls, cozy loungewear, embroidered throws Kiss Day (13 February) Perfume, couple T-shirts, personalized playlists, romantic date setup Valentine's Day (14 February) Jewellery, luxury handbags, photo albums, romantic getaway, quality time Rose Day (February 7): Start with Elegance Rose Day is the kick-off to Valentine Week, and flowers are timeless symbols of love. Instead of a simple bouquet, consider a rose-themed scarf, handbag, or jewellery piece. A rose pendant or bracelet engraved with initials or a special date adds a personal touch, blending romance with style. These gifts turn the symbolism of roses into something wearable and memorable. Propose Day (February 8): Celebrate Commitment Propose Day is ideal for reaffirming your bond. Even if you’re not proposing, a personalized engagement ring box, a vintage-inspired watch, or a framed photo of a cherished memory can make the day special. Heartfelt gestures like love letters or curated playlists can make Propose Day unforgettable, showing your commitment beyond material gifts. Also Read: Valentine Week 2026 Calender: Full list of important dates from 7 Feb to 14 Feb Valentine Week 2026 dates Chocolate Day (February 9): Sweetness with Style Chocolate Day is about indulgence and thoughtful gifting. Chocolate-coloured handbags, shoes, or leather accessories combine practicality with romance. Pairing these with artisanal chocolates or chocolate-scented candles creates a perfect mix of style and sweetness, making your gift both memorable and useful. Teddy Day 2026 (February 10): Comfort and Charm Teddy Day is all about the warmth, coziness, and extra love. Although it may seem a bit childish, it is playful and allows everyone to give and share gifts that are soft and cuddly, and that may be the starting point for some new personal relationships. A teddy bear is a classic gift for this day, and will be a great way to start a new relationship . But so would be gifting a teddy bear themed purse or great teddy bear printed comfy loungewear. Cozy sweaters, PJ sets, or soft blankets can give the same warm feeling as a hug, making gifts for Teddy Day feel special. Also, a little personal touch to a gift goes a long way, so putting some initials or a personal message on a towel or blanket will make the gift even more special. 2026 Promise Day (February 11): Buy a Meaningful Gift This day is all about gifts that have meaning. Engrave an important date or initials on a bracelet, and it turns something as simple as a bracelet or a trinket into something that signifies commitment. You can also find gifts that spark emotional connection and sentimental value to express your feelings on this day. You can always get a promise journal where you and your partner can write vows to each other. In addition to these, there are other very inexpensive things that can be gifted to celebrate you inside jokes and intimate relationship. Something like a personalized key chain, or mugs and other DIYs things can represent a very strong promise. Hug Day 2026 (February 12): Wrap Them in Warmth Hug Day is all about physical and emotional closeness. While giving a hug is the main gesture, gifts that convey comfort and warmth are perfect for this day. Think oversized blankets, soft shawls, or pashmina wraps that your partner can wrap themselves in. You can get a blanket and some comfy clothing, and add a scented candle or a pillow to make the day not only special, but also comfortable, and share a warm evening with each other. Kiss Day 2026 (February 13): Celebrate Your Romance Kiss Day is a great day to celebrate romance, and spend some time together to tie the day to the love holiday. Think about gifts that are not really physical together. Don’t forget about the romance. Instead, focus on love song playlists, custom love letters, and romance-focused gifts. These make a great addition to the car ride or candlelit dinner to change a normal date into a great memory. Couple's gifts like matching shirts or a special scent combo complete the day perfectly. Valentine's Day 2026 (February 14): The Big Finale Valentine's Day marks the end of a week filled with love, and care. While the occasion often calls for big displays of affection, what counts most is the thought and effort put in. Gifts like jewellery, high-end handbags, custom photo books, or a romantic trip can turn the day into something special. Also Read: Rose Day 2026: Don’t just give a bouquet, add a personalised gift your partner would love Simple activities like preparing food as a team, organizing an outdoor meal, or dedicating time to chat and enjoying each other's company can also be a nice way celebrating the day with your partner. The main goal is to make your significant other feel valued and adored transforming Valentine's Day into a lasting memory that extends beyond the day itself. Valentine Week isn’t just for couples — it’s the perfect time to show appreciation for friends and family. Galentine’s Day: Chic matching jewellery sets, customized T-shirts, or friendship bracelets that reflect your bond Memory-themed gifts: Personalized tote bags, handbags, or custom fashion portraits capturing a special memory By giving personalized, stylish, and thoughtful gifts, Valentine Week can become a celebration not just of romantic love, but of all the meaningful connections in your life.

items.headline: Mother’s Day 2026: DIY creative and heartfelt gift ideas to make your mom feel extra special

items.headline: Valentine’s Day gift ideas: 5 tech picks your partner will actually use
items.body: iPhone 17 Top 5 tech gifts for Valentine's: iPhone 17, iPad, Apple Watch Marshall speakers and Sony noise cancellation headphones also recommended These gifts focus on comfort, routine, and improving daily life Did our AI summary help? Market Mastery Webinar by Vishal Malkan Find the weak links in your portfolio by Vishal Malkan Valentine’s Day gifting often comes with pressure. You want something that feels meaningful, not rushed, and ideally something your partner will actually use long after February 14 is over. Tech gifts can work well here, not because they are flashy, but because the right device becomes part of everyday life. When chosen thoughtfully, they can feel personal rather than transactional. Here are five tech gifts that make sense as Valentine’s Day presents, especially if your partner values comfort, routine, and things that quietly improve daily life. iPhone 17 The iPhone 17 is already available in India and is one of the most personal gifts you can give. A phone is something your partner uses constantly. It holds photos, messages, notes, and memories. Gifting an iPhone means upgrading something that is deeply woven into their daily life. The iPhone 17 offers strong performance, reliable battery life, and cameras that are good enough for both casual photos and special moments. It does not demand attention but works smoothly in the background, which is exactly what many people want from a phone. In India, the iPhone 17 starts at around Rs 80,000 depending on storage. It is expensive, but it is also a long-term gift that your partner will use every single day. iPad Related Stories Jailed conman Sukesh Chandrasekhar claims to gift Jacqueline Fernandez Rs 30 crore helicopter in Val... 'Don’t wait, spend Valentine's...': Trump administration’s ‘self-deport’ message to migrants... 'This is so pathetic': Maduro Arrest, Greenland Romance? White House drops political Valentine An iPad is a thoughtful gift for someone who enjoys reading, watching shows, sketching, or simply browsing on a larger screen. It fits neatly between a phone and a laptop and does not feel intimidating to use. Many people use their iPad during relaxed moments, such as in bed, on the sofa, or while travelling, which gives it a more personal feel than a work device. The standard iPad in India starts at around Rs 39,900, making it a practical option that still feels special without being excessive. Apple Watch The Apple Watch makes sense as a Valentine’s Day gift because it is subtle and caring rather than showy. It tracks daily movement, sleep, and basic health indicators, often reminding users to slow down or move a little more. It is not about pushing fitness goals aggressively, but about awareness and balance. Gifting an Apple Watch can feel like a quiet way of saying you care about your partner’s wellbeing. In India, Apple Watch models typically start at around Rs 41,900, depending on size and variant. Marshall speakers Marshall speakers are ideal for partners who love music and appreciate design. They do not try to blend in, and that is part of their charm. Whether it is a compact portable speaker or a larger one for the living room, Marshall speakers encourage intentional listening. They work well for shared playlists, relaxed evenings at home, or small gatherings. Prices in India usually start at around Rs 10,000 and go up based on size and power, making them suitable for a wide range of budgets. Sony noise cancellation headphones Noise cancellation headphones are one of the most practical gifts you can give. Sony’s models are especially popular among people who commute, travel frequently, or simply need quiet time to focus or relax. Good noise cancellation can turn a noisy environment into a calm one, whether your partner is listening to music, podcasts, or nothing at all. These headphones are about comfort and escape rather than attention. In India, Sony’s noise cancelling headphones are typically priced between Rs 25,000 and Rs 30,000. In the end, Valentine’s Day gifts do not need to be dramatic to be meaningful. The best ones are useful, familiar, and fit naturally into your partner’s life. These five tech products work not because they are trendy, but because they quietly make everyday moments better. That is often what makes a gift truly memorable.

items.headline: What to do with mom this Mother’s Day weekend: Meaningful ideas that turn simple moments into lasting memo
items.body: Mother’s Day is more than flowers, greeting cards and last-minute gifts. For many moms, the best present is something far simpler — quality time with the people they love most. This year, Mother’s Day falls on Sunday, May 10, making it the perfect excuse to slow down and create memories together. Whether your mom enjoys quiet afternoons, outdoor adventures, creative hobbies or family traditions, there are countless ways to make the weekend feel personal and special. From heartfelt activities at home to fun outings outdoors, the goal is to make her feel appreciated.ALSO READ: Wordle Answer May 8: Hints, tips and solution revealed to decode puzzle #1784Mother’s Day celebrations do not have to be extravagant to feel unforgettable. Sometimes, the moments that matter most are the quiet ones — sharing tea together, taking a walk, laughing over a board game or simply helping her relax for once.ALSO READ: The JPMorgan harassment suit against Lorna Hajdini that went viral has one massive problem — it may be fakeHow can you make Mother’s Day feel more personal?One thoughtful idea is planting a tree together. It is a meaningful activity that grows more special over time. Some families even plant one tree for each child, turning it into a lasting family tradition. Watching it grow year after year becomes a beautiful reminder of shared memories.If your mom enjoys flowers, skip the store-bought bouquet and spend time arranging flowers together instead. Picking out blooms from a local market and building custom arrangements creates something more personal than any pre-made gift.For moms who love nature, a visit to a botanical garden or conservancy can turn into a peaceful afternoon surrounded by flowers and fresh air. A simple nature walk, bike ride or kite-flying session can also feel surprisingly nostalgic and fun.Another deeply appreciated gesture is helping with chores. Cleaning the house, organizing a room or tackling projects she has been putting off can become one of the most meaningful gifts of all.ALSO READ: The ex-JPMorgan banker at the center of harassment suit against Lorna Hajdini just quietly left his new job tooWhich activities create the best family memories?Shared experiences tend to leave the strongest memories behind. Hosting a picnic in a park, by the beach or even in the backyard creates an easygoing atmosphere where everyone can relax together. Movie marathons are another cozy way to celebrate. Gather Mom’s favorite films, prepare snacks and settle in for an evening dedicated entirely to her favourite stories.Board games also bring families together in a way few things can. Whether it’s a classic game everyone grew up playing or something new, the laughter and friendly competition make the day memorable.Cooking together is another idea that turns ordinary moments into something special. Homemade cookies, pasta, jam or desserts can become both a bonding activity and a keepsake memory. Even preparing brunch in bed or afternoon tea can feel thoughtful when it’s done with care.Some families may want to create a completely new tradition. It could be watching the same movie every year, cooking a favorite recipe or creating a gratitude jar filled with handwritten notes explaining why Mom is loved and appreciated.ALSO READ: 'Never forget, I own you': Explicit remarks and racist slurs—JPMorgan Exec Lorna Hajdini faces fresh allegations in refiled harassment lawsuitWhat simple gestures mean the most to moms?Many moms simply want uninterrupted time with family. Visiting relatives, reconnecting with old friends or spending the day talking without distractions can mean more than expensive presents. A spa day at home is another easy but thoughtful option. Candles, relaxing music, face masks and massages can transform an ordinary afternoon into something restorative and comforting.Creative activities can also bring families closer. Making custom Mother’s Day shirts, crafting together, creating scrapbooks or assembling a time capsule filled with photographs and handwritten notes can preserve memories for years.For adventurous moms, scavenger hunts, outdoor hikes or trying a brand-new hobby together can make the weekend feel exciting. Knitting, painting, photography or even taking a cooking class online can become a fun shared experience.Animal lovers might enjoy spending the day at a zoo, aquarium or wildlife preserve. Others may prefer a shopping trip, afternoon tea or a quick getaway to a nearby destination.Volunteering together can also make the holiday more meaningful. Helping at a food bank, animal shelter or community event gives families a chance to spend quality time together while helping others.Some families may want to create music-filled memories by attending a concert or curating a playlist of songs that remind them of home, childhood and family traditions.A few newer ideas can also make Mother’s Day stand out this year. Families can create a “memory picnic” by bringing old photo albums outdoors, host a backyard brunch with handwritten menus, or spend the evening sharing favorite family stories around a bonfire or dining table.At its heart, Mother’s Day is not really about perfection. It is about making moms feel seen, appreciated and loved.The most memorable celebrations are often built around small moments — conversations over tea, laughter during a board game, homemade desserts cooling in the kitchen or a quiet walk through a garden. Flowers fade and gifts eventually get forgotten. Time together usually does not.ALSO READ: Quote of the Day by Abraham Lincoln: 'When you have got an elephant by the hind leg…'—Inspiring quotes by the 16th president of the United States who played a major role in the abolition of slaveryFAQsWhat do most moms really want on Mother’s Day?For many moms, quality time and thoughtful gestures matter more than expensive gifts.What’s an easy Mother’s Day activity for families?A picnic, movie night, brunch at home or cooking together are simple ideas that create lasting memories.
items.snippet: Mother's Day weekend offers a chance to create cherished memories with Mom. Forget material gifts and focus on shared experiences. From picnics and movie marathons to gardening and cooking together, these simple activities foster connection. Helping with chores or enjoying a spa day at home also shows appreciation. These thoughtful gestures make moms feel seen and loved.

items.headline: Priyanka Chopra on learning Telugu for Varanasi with Mahesh Babu: I have no idea how to improvise back...
items.body: Priyanka Chopra talks about learning Telugu for Varanasi Priyanka Chopra is phonetically memorizing Telugu for her role in Varanasi S S Rajamouli guides Priyanka through language challenges and improvisation Varanasi is confirmed as a single-part film with a three-hour runtime Did our AI summary help? Market Mastery Webinar by Vishal Malkan Find the weak links in your portfolio by Vishal Malkan Priyanka Chopra has opened up with rare honesty about the realities of working in a language she does not speak while preparing for Varanasi, her much-anticipated collaboration with director S S Rajamouli. For an actor who has moved fluidly across industries and continents, the challenge this time is not scale or spectacle, but language. Rather than learning Telugu in the conventional sense, Priyanka Chopra admitted that her process is far more painstaking. She explained, “I don't know if I am learning the language yet. I'm phonetically memorizing my words and saying them. So, I can pick up like yes, Telugu is not a language I understand or speak.” View this post on Instagram A post shared by CinemaBlend (@cinemablend) The difficulty, she revealed, intensifies when scenes require improvisation. “But yeah, that's super tough to, you know, especially if you have to improvise on set, like I have no idea how to improvise back with him in the language that's this mother tongue, you know?” Throughout this process, Priyanka Chopra has leaned heavily on S S Rajamouli, whom she credits as a steady guide on set. “I Really rely on our director, S S Rajamouli to help me with what that is. He'll phonetically come and say it to me.” When improvisation comes into play, the work becomes even more layered. “Especially if there's improv, I'll take like ten minutes to kind of memorize it, understand what the tone is, understand what each word means, and then say it in my own way.” For Priyanka Chopra, this goes beyond pronunciation. She described it as “an added layer of performance,” one that forces her to think deeply about emotion, rhythm and intent every time she steps into a new linguistic world. It is demanding, but not unfamiliar. “Which I have done in the past. But yeas, its not easy. But I love a challenge so that's good.” The challenge, for her, is part of the thrill. Away from the intensity of the set, a lighter moment recently offered a glimpse into the personal side of the Varanasi team. During an international interview, Mahesh Babu, Priyanka Chopra and Prithviraj Sukumaran spoke about their favourite Indian dishes. Mahesh Babu kept it close to home, saying, “Hyderabadi chicken biryani, I love it. I had it yesterday actually, it was quite good.” The answer delighted fans, especially those who see the dish as inseparable from Hyderabad’s identity. Also Read: SS Rajamouli’s Varanasi starring Mahesh Babu and Priyanka Chopra set to officially release on April 7, 2027 Meanwhile, excitement around Varanasi continues to build. Addressing speculation that the film might be split into two parts, S S Rajamouli clarified, “We considered it briefly and we quickly dropped the idea. It's a one part film.” He also confirmed a runtime of three hours. In the film, Priyanka Chopra plays Mandakini, Mahesh Babu essays Rudra, and Prithviraj Sukumaran steps into the role of the sharp antagonist Kumba.
items.snippet: Priyanka Chopra has spoken candidly about the unique challenge of working in an unfamiliar language while preparing for Varanasi, her upcoming film with director S S Rajamouli. The global star revealed that instead of fluently learning Telugu, she is carefully memorising her lines phonetically, making improvisation on set particularly demanding.

items.headline: Quote of the day by Emily Bronte: ‘I had dreams that have stayed with me and changed my ideas. They have g
items.body: Emily Brontë remains one of the most influential figures in English literature, celebrated for her remarkable contribution to classic literature, Victorian poetry, and timeless storytelling. Known for her profound imagination, emotional depth, and distinctive literary voice, the 19th-century British novelist and poet continues to captivate readers worldwide. Her life, writing style, and literary legacy have become subjects of enduring fascination among literature enthusiasts. Brontë’s exploration of human emotions, nature, isolation, and societal complexities helped shape literary history, making her an iconic author whose brilliance continues to inspire generations of readers and scholars.Today’s quote of the day by Emily Brontë offers a deep insight into the power of dreams and imagination in today’s hyper-realistic world. Her words, ‘I had dreams that have stayed with me and changed my ideas. They have gone through me like wine through water’ is mentioned in Chapter IX of Brontë’s iconic novel Wuthering Heights. The thought-provoking lines appear during a pivotal conversation between Catherine and her housekeeper, Nelly Dean. Catherine is attempting to explain her deep, metaphysical connection to Heathcliff and why her soul feels tethered to his, despite her decision to marry Edgar Linton.Quote of the day by Emily Brontë: Lasting power of inner visionEmily Brontë reflects on how powerful inner experiences can permanently reshape thought, identity, and personal perspective. She suggests that certain aspirations, emotions, or imaginative moments leave deep psychological imprints that continue influencing choices long after they occur. In the real world, this can relate to life-changing ambitions, transformative memories, or deeply personal revelations that alter one’s worldview. Such internal experiences often guide creativity, emotional intelligence, and self-discovery. Her insight highlights how profound mental and emotional encounters can shape personal evolution beyond immediate circumstances.130903634Emily Brontë quote of the day: Transformation through emotional experienceEmily Brontë also emphasizes that meaningful internal experiences do not simply pass through life unchanged but instead become part of personal growth and emotional transformation. In modern life, dreams, goals, and deeply felt experiences often influence career paths, relationships, and creative expression. People are frequently shaped by the visions they carry and the emotional depth they experience. This perspective connects strongly to self-awareness, resilience, and identity formation. Her words remind us that what deeply moves the mind can gradually redefine beliefs, strengthen purpose, and contribute to a richer understanding of oneself and the world.More about Emily BrontëEmily Brontë was born in 1818 in Yorkshire and grew up as one of six children in the remarkably literary Brontë household. Among her siblings were fellow renowned authors Charlotte Brontë and Anne Brontë. Emily led a quiet and private existence, spending much of her life in Haworth, where the wild and dramatic moors surrounding her home became a powerful source of inspiration for her creative work. The rugged natural environment deeply shaped both her imagination and distinctive literary voice.Though her life was tragically brief, ending in 1848 when she was only 30 years old, Brontë’s contribution to literature remains extraordinary. Her only novel, Wuthering Heights, released in 1847 under the pseudonym Ellis Bell, challenged the literary standards of its era through its raw emotional intensity, morally complex figures, and haunting exploration of passion, vengeance, and solitude. While the novel initially divided critics, it has since gained recognition as one of English literature’s most innovative and influential masterpieces, securing Emily Brontë’s enduring status as a major literary force.The last cinematic adaptation of Wuthering Heights, featuring Margot Robbie and Jacob Elordi, premiered on February 13 this year. While the film was praised for its cinematography, costumes, score and terrific performance, critics are divided, with many finding it a ‘hollow’ or ‘vapid’ take that frames a deeply toxic story as a fashionable tragedy.
items.snippet: Quote of the day by Emily Brontë explores dreams, imagination, and emotional transformation through the English writer's timeless literary wisdom. From Wuthering Heights to her lasting influence on Victorian literature, Emily Brontës powerful reflections on inner vision, personal growth, and human emotion continue inspiring readers, writers, and literature enthusiasts worldwide.

items.headline: Left Rs 52 LPA job, now runs Rs 5 crore momo business: Gurgaon man explains how small idea turned big
items.body: Gurgaon man quits job, builds Rs 5 crore momo brand. (AI-generated image) In a time when many professionals focus on high-paying corporate jobs, some choose to follow a very different path. Saket Saurabh, a Gurgaon-based entrepreneur, decided to leave a well-paying position to pursue a business that started small but grew rapidly. Saket, co-founder and CEO of The Momos Mafia, launched the venture after quitting his job in 2023, and in just two-and-a-half years, the business has generated over Rs 5 crore in revenue. He shared an Instagram video with the caption, “ 50 lakh ki job resign kar chale momo business karne. ” Saket’s decision came after a successful career in the corporate world. After graduating from NIFT Delhi in 2014, he co-founded Wowflux. When the company was acquired by FlixStock, he joined as a product manager, earning Rs 52 lakh per annum by September 2023. Despite the high salary, he chose to take a different route. In an interview with HT.com, Saket revealed that before leaving his job, he had already tested the food business. He joined his sister and brother-in-law in running the Bamboo Café in Gurgaon. “It was a generic cafe. We were selling everything. As an experiment, we opened a small canopy selling only momos right outside the cafe,” he said. Encouraged by the response, Saket and his partners opened a cart at a location called Infotech in Gurgaon . “That cart did great business. We were doing Rs 10,000 to Rs 12,000 in sales every day. We met many office workers at that stall who wanted to open their own momo carts. That’s how the franchising business started,” he explained. The business now has five partners. After a year of operating carts, Saket realised that they alone could not form a scalable business. “After doing this for one year, I realised that momo carts could not grow into a meaningful, scalable business. A Rs 500 crore brand cannot be built around carts,” he said. Aware that most momo sales take place on the roadside, the team adopted a new approach. They began opening small shops with carts outside, a model they call CSR - Cart Service Restaurant. Saket said that in the first year, the company earned Rs 16 lakh. “In the 2023-24 financial year, for the three months of January, February and March, we did Rs 16 lakh,” he said. He further revealed, “Last year, we did Rs 2.2 crore. This year, we have already done Rs 2.2 crore, and we will be closing this year at Rs 3 crore. So in two-and-a-half years, we have earned more than Rs 5 crore. Talking about advice for those entering the momo business, Saket said, “Start with a proper outlet. Do not start with a stall. With a stall, you can earn maybe a lakh, 2 lakh or 4 lakh. But when you talk about the bigger number and a proper business thing, start with an outlet. This is one of my big learnings.”
items.snippet: After quitting his Rs 52 LPA corporate job, Gurgaon man Saket Saurabh turned a small momo stall into a growing business. In just two-and-a-half years, his company, The Momos Mafia, has earned over Rs 5 crore.

items.headline: Vodafone Idea's Rs 35,000-crore fresh loan request under lenders' scanner: Report
items.body: Vodafone Idea Lenders to review Vi's Rs 35,000 crore loan request, reports Mint. AGR dues frozen at Rs 87,695 crore, to be repaid under revised schedule Vodafone Idea's Q3 net loss narrowed to Rs 5,286 crore, ARPU rose 7.3% YoY Did our AI summary help? Market Mastery Webinar by Vishal Malkan Find the weak links in your portfolio by Vishal Malkan IC8 Watchlist Portfolio Message Follow NSE/BSE Select NSE LIVE BSE LIVE Day High Day Low Volume (NSE) More × Add to Watchlist Vodafone Idea’s spectrum dues, subscriber losses and weak user revenue are being examined by lenders before taking a call on the telecom's giant's request for a fresh loan Rs 35,000 crore, a report said. The shares of the company dropped around 2 percent to Rs 11.11 apiece in the morning trading hours of Thursday. An external techno-economic viability (TEV) study which was done in 2024 to examine Vodafone Idea ’s creditworthiness will now be updated with new projections, Mint reported citing people familiar with the matter. The report added that no new TEV will be done for now. The update will also consider the recent adjusted gross revenue (AGR) relief announced by the Supreme Court, which came after the 2024 TEV, the report further said. The Supreme Court last year allowed the Centre to reconsider Vodafone Idea's additional AGR dues raised for the period up to FY2016-17, as per the order copy. One of the sources cited by Mint said that the lenders still don't have any clarity on the teleco's spectrum dues, which are substantially higher than the AGR. The report further quoted the person as saying that the company has been forthcoming with data to aid the process before the lenders discuss the plan with the consortium. The final call on the loan will be taken only after that, the report added. Moneycontrol couldn't independently verify the report. Vodafone Idea CEO Abhijit Kishore last week said that the company is thankful to the government for offering a definitive, long-term and conclusive solution on the AGR matter . On January 8 this year, the Department of Telecommunications (DoT) informed the company that its AGR dues — including principal, interest, penalty and interest on penalty — for the period from FY2006-07 to FY2018-19, as of December 31, 2025, would be frozen and repaid under a revised framework. Under the new schedule, the company will pay up to Rs 124 crore annually over six years from March 2026 to March 2031, followed by annual payments of Rs 100 crore over the next four years from March 2032 to March 2035. The remaining reassessed AGR dues, without any further interest, will be cleared in equal annual instalments over six years from March 2036 to March 2041. The DoT will set up a committee to reassess the AGR dues, and its decision will be final and binding on the company, which has given an undertaking to that effect. In a separate communication issued the same day, the DoT confirmed that the AGR dues frozen as of December 31, 2025, amount to Rs 87,695 crore, subject to reassessment. Vodafone Idea Q3 Results: The telecom company last week reported a marginal narrowing of its net loss to Rs 5,286 crore for the quarter ended December 31, 2024, compared with a loss of Rs 6,609 crore in the corresponding period of the previous financial year. Revenue from operations rose to Rs 11,323 crore in Q3FY26, up from Rs 11,117 crore in Q3FY25. EBITDA improved to Rs 4,816 crore from Rs 4,712 crore a year ago.
